summary.text: Krista Griffith has represented the 12th District in the Delaware House of Representatives since 2018.

paragraphs.text: Griffith is an attorney who served for nearly a decade as a Deputy Attorney General in the Delaware Department of Justice, leaving in 2015.
Griffith holds a law degree from Suffolk University Law School and a bachelor of arts from the University of New Hampshire.
